author: Zenith_Ai
text:
🚨 Google Gemini has powerful tools most people never use.

Here are 7 features that will save you hours of work, explained simply so anyone can use them:👇👇

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text:
1/ Canvas (Side-by-Side Editing)

》How to use it: Open Canvas from the tools menu.

》What it does: It splits your screen. Gemini creates dashboards, writes an article, email, or code on one side, and you edit it live on the other. You can highlight specific sentences for the AI

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text:
2/ Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)

》How to use it: Open Notebook from the sidebar and upload your files.

》What it does: You can upload PDFs, notes, or YouTube videos. The AI will answer your questions using only the files you uploaded. It will not guess or make things up, making

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text:
3/ AI Image Editor

》How to use it: Type a description or upload a photo directly in the chat.

》What it does: You can create pictures from scratch or edit your own using just words. Simply tell the AI to "remove the background," "make the shirt red," or "turn this into a

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text:
4/ Deep Research

》How to use it: Select the Deep Research option and give it a broad topic.

》What it does: Instead of giving you a quick, short answer, the AI acts like a hired researcher. It browses dozens of websites, compares the facts, and writes a detailed, structured

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text:
5/ Gems (Custom Assistants)

》How to use it: Click "Gems" → "Create New".

》What it does: You can build custom, mini-AIs for specific everyday tasks—like a strict proofreader, a meal planner, or a math tutor. You teach it the rules once, and it remembers exactly how to behave

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text:
6/ Connect Google Workspace

》How to use it: Go to Settings → Apps and connect your Workspace.

》What it does: It links Gemini to your personal Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar. Instead of searching through folders, you can just ask: "What time is my meeting tomorrow?" or

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text:
7/ Live Voice

》How to use it: Tap the microphone icon on the Gemini phone app.

》What it does: It lets you talk to the AI like you are on a real phone call. It understands natural speech, meaning you can brainstorm out loud, practice for an interview, or even interrupt the AI

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
Max
topReplies.text: Really enjoyed this post. It’s thoughtful, beautifully expressed, and genuinely refreshing to read.

topReplies.author: Zenith_Ai
topReplies.text: Thanks, Max. Deep Research and Gems have saved me the most time. What’s the one you use most?
